reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static String movingSums(String s){try{String[]p=s.split(";",-1);if(p.length!=2||p[1].isEmpty()||!p[0].matches("[1-9][0-9]*"))return null;int w=Integer.parseInt(p[0]);if(w>100000)return null;var a=new ArrayList<Long>();for(String x:p[1].split(",",-1)){if(!x.matches("0|[1-9][0-9]*"))return null;long v=Long.parseLong(x);if(v>10000000)return null;a.add(v);}if(a.size()<w)return null;long v=0;for(int i=0;i<w;i++)v+=a.get(i);if(v>10000000)return null;var o=new ArrayList<String>();o.add(""+v);for(int i=w;i<a.size();i++){v+=a.get(i)-a.get(i-w);if(v>10000000)return null;o.add(""+v);}return String.join(",",o);}catch(Exception e){return null;}}}
